You begin along the difficult path, the road is rocky, barely discernable from the raw land around you. There is deep moss and large roots protruding across your path.
Give me a group survival check (DC20)
- Success: As you follow the path you peer over the side of the road, below you a gigantic pit of fog, faint wails echoing out from the depths, calling you deeper... You steel your nerves against the temptation and continue forward. [[#The Whispering Woods]]
- Failure: You find yourselves off of the trodden path, wandering into a large cloud of fog, you can see clearly your immediate surroundings but there is no sign of the path [[#The Fog of Fear]]

### The Whispering Woods
As you continue you enter a grove of willow trees, the path ends and begins a wooden bridge, no railings, barely inches above the water around you. The willow branches and leaves hang low and block your vision, preventing you from seeing the area around you clearly. The soft wind begins to pick up just slightly, and you begin to hear voices... faint whispering voices calling out to you, "Join us, it's dangerous, you cannot win, join us and be safe here. There are no Devils, no Kings, no Mothers, just the warm embrace of the Willows."
- **STAGE 1: THE WHISPERS:** As the voices whisper to you your vision begins to blur and you stumble slightly, make a perception check to try to keep following the real path. (DC 14)
	- Failure: Anyone who fails begins to step away from the path, at first their feet landing on moss and roots, and then they plunge as they step off solid ground and tumble down into the murky water. 
	- Success: You watch as your friends who failed slowly turn away from you, unresponsive to your attempts to wake them or call to them, as they attempt to throw themselves into the misty water below.
- **STAGE 2: THE LIES:** As the voices grow and swell, they begin to fill your mind with foreign thoughts. New names, new experiences, as if you are losing yourself. The memories of your friends face, you were someone else, a farmhand, a soldier, anything that you aren't they begin to tell you that you are, and you start to believe. Make an insight check to resist the whispers and retain your memory of who you are. (DC 16)
	- Failure: You know who you were, the struggles, the pain, but you know who the whispers want you to be. The life without suffering, stay here, the warm embrace of the willows will protect you from the horrors you are walking towards.
	- Success: You retain who you are, and you feel a newfound resolve against the darkness you plan to face. 
- Anyone who fails both checks takes a level of exhaustion as they force themselves through the rough, swimming and grabbing roots as they fight to survive the grip of the enchantment.
- As you all struggle to maintain your composure, you begin to see the trees thin, and clear skies ahead of you in a rocky area. As you break free from the trees you see your friends who failed checks desperately crawling from the swamp, barely awake after fighting the magical and mental pull they were under. 
- [[THE WEAVER OF OUR WORLD]]

### The Fog of Fear
You stumble and fall as you walk through the fog, the ground covered in a thick milky cloud that makes it impossible to even see what is beneath you. As the fog thins you see your friends standing around you, and a mass of fog congeals in the center taking an almost humanoid form, with a head arms and legs.
It stands in the center of you all, slowly panning between you, as it does it looks directly at Antigone, and its form begins to change. Everyone else watches as the cloud grows to be a humanoid woman clad in a blood red dress, black armored shoulder pauldrons and a metal corset, on her back an elegant red scimitar, already dripping with blood. She reaches forward to you Antigone as you recoil from her grasp, she laughs and lunges forward, slashing her claws across your chest.
Everyone make an Insight check for me, Antigone yours will be at disadvantage (DC 16). Those who pass know it is an illusion and may be afraid but not magically. Those who fail are afraid of the phantom and believe it to be real. 
Antigone, as you look up at the terrifying form of your mother you feel deep fear. A need to run, even if you had your weapons and spells you couldn't beat her. Describe how Catherine looks in Antigone's mind.
Does she tower over you, her weapons dripping in the blood of her victims? Everything Antigone describes comes to be, and the more afraid they are the more powerful Catherine becomes.

##### COMBAT?:
**ENEMIES:** Catherin Rex mirage, cannot be hit/damaged, +5 to hit and deals 2d6+5 slashing damage. 

Catherine attacks them as they try to fight her but are unable to as the miss or their attacks pass through her harmlessly. The only way to defeat her is to help Antigone realize she isn't real. 
Antigone, every time you look at Catherine, you feel fear, and she grows taller, more imposing. 
As the fear fades so does the mirage, eventually dissipating into harmless mist. 
The fog begins to lift and you see the road around you clearly, leading you up the path, realizing you were only a few steps away from the Tears of Stone all along.

[[THE WEAVER OF OUR WORLD]]
